error.auth_failed: The request could not be authenticated.
error.card_not_present: Insert your card into the reader.
error.cert_not_found: No certificate was found with that thumbprint.
error.cert_not_usable: This certificate cannot be used for signing.
error.certificate_listing_disabled: Listing certificates for other programs is switched off in this copy of Liro Bridge. Turn it on in Settings.
error.consent_timeout: No answer was given in time, so nothing was signed.
error.document_signing_disabled: Signing whole documents is switched off in this copy of Liro Bridge. Turn it on in Settings.
error.input_unreadable: The document could not be read. It may be open in another program, or no longer where it was.
error.job_in_progress: This application already has a signing job running. Wait for it to finish.
error.job_not_found: That signing job is no longer available. Its result has already been collected, or it expired.
error.no_reader: No card reader detected. Connect the reader and try again.
error.not_paired: This application is not paired with Liro Bridge.
error.output_exists: A file with that name already exists, so nothing was overwritten.
error.output_in_use: The signed document could not replace the existing file because that file is open in another program. Close it and try again.
error.output_write_failed: The signed document could not be written to disk. Check the folder and the free space.
error.pairing_code_incorrect: That code is not the one shown in the window.
error.pairing_expired: That connection request is no longer valid. Start a new one.
error.pairing_in_progress: Another application is being connected right now. Try again shortly.
error.pairing_origin_mismatch: The connection was confirmed from a different origin than the one that requested it.
error.pdf_encrypted: The input is a password-protected PDF.
error.pdf_invalid: The input is not a readable PDF document.
error.pin_incorrect: Incorrect PIN. Attempts remaining before the card is blocked are limited.
error.pin_locked: The card is blocked. Unblock it with your PUK using your issuer's software.
error.rate_limited: The application asked too often. Try again shortly.
error.request_invalid: The application sent a request Liro Bridge could not read.
error.sign_failed: The card failed to produce a signature.
error.smart_card_service_down: The Windows Smart Card service is not running.
error.stamp_glyph_missing: The stamp contains a character the font does not support: %s (%s).
error.tsa_client_cert_invalid: The timestamp client certificate could not be opened. Check its password in Settings.
error.tsa_client_cert_unreadable: The timestamp client certificate file could not be read. Check the path in Settings.
error.tsa_rejected: The timestamp service refused the request.
error.tsa_unavailable: The timestamp service is not responding.
error.version_too_old: This version of Liro Bridge is too old for the application that called it.

settings.certificate_listing: Let programs ask which certificates are on this machine

settings.document_signing: Let programs send whole documents to be signed
settings.document_signing_hint: When this is off, programs can still ask for a signature over a hash they computed themselves — the agent then never receives the document at all.

settings.export_failed: The audit log could not be exported.
